name: sqlfrontend-spike-main-limits
body: The spike Program.Main reports only plain CREATE statements (ScriptDom models CREATE OR ALTER and ALTER as separate statement classes, which it skips) and blanks SQLCMD ':' lines to empty lines, so the line count holds but columns on those lines do not. Upgrade when Main is rewired onto SqlSourceReader (same-length neutralisation) and SchemaEmitter (CREATE OR ALTER / ALTER declarations).
